name: Izzy & Fiona
core: Wives before paper. Blood rejected them and Fiona claimed Izzy louder. Twin brats, twin worship, synchronised and shameless.
weddingNote: a second ceremony for a marriage that already existed
note: Wives before paper, and wives before the Family knew it. Blood rejected them and Fiona claimed Izzy louder. The Arc 11 ceremony changes nothing about their marriage and everything about its witnesses — it is the Found Family standing up to honour them properly. Worth holding against Ceri and Dessie, who were also married before the Family knew and never wanted a second rite. Two couples, two answers, both correct.
